name: residual-comparison-211
launchCondition: Wait for both current continuation milestones. If neither exceeds parent development team point estimate, test this controlled architecture change. Otherwise reassess before launch.
hypothesis: Current actor scores candidates via a state/action dot product without direct nonlinear reference to baseline candidate. A zero-output initialized comparison head may learn opportunity-cost differences while preserving initial parent outputs. This is a hypothesis, not established cause of plateau.
initialization: Same parent actor/critic; fresh Adam/RNG in both arms. CPU RNG isolated during extra head construction. No changed feature encoding or reward.

development.report: All four checkpoints and paired between-arm endpoint difference; seven lineups and hero/mixed controls. Reused development only.

decision: Do not tune after viewing partial results. Preserve all arms and checkpoints. No automatic deployment. Choose further experiment only after complete comparisons.
